name: Kotae –  automate customer inquiries for your website with AI chatbot
author: kotae

sections.description:
Kotae: Smart Chatbot for Small Businesses
Featured on ProductHunt #1 Product of the Day

Create your AI chat bot in minutes and launch it on your website.
Use this plugin to add your pre-trained Kotae chat widget directly into your WordPress site.
Automate customer inquiries and find out what your visitors are looking for.

Kotae is perfect for…

  • SMEs with too many inquiries to deal with
    Kotae automates incoming customer inquiries on your website so you can spend more time growing your business.

  • Companies looking for deeper insights
    Knowing where your traffic comes from is half the battle. Kotae goes beyond that to tell you what visitors are looking for and how often they find it.

  • Businesses who want to drive traffic to specific pages
    Link common keywords that your visitors use so that Kotae immediately gives them the right page to go to.

Transform your inbound funnel

  • Filter out Low-quality Leads
    Get notifications when your visitors are ready to convert, with leads sent straight to your email.

  • Beyond Analytics
    See what questions your users are asking and if they’re getting the answers they’re looking for.

  • Powerful Integrations
    Plug into the tools you already use, like Facebook Messenger and WordPress, or add Kotae to any website in seconds.

  • Quick & Easy Training
    Kotae becomes an expert on your business by quickly reading through your website and any files you upload.

  • Custom Answers
    Create tailored responses to your most common questions and Kotae will ensure your customers get the right answer every time.

  • Natural Language
    Kotae responds to customers in their own language, making every conversation feel like they’re talking to a local representative.

Reviews

“We wanted a quick solution without developing it in-house and tried different products. I saw your product on Product Hunt and decided to give it a try. At first, it really gives an answer related to the user and adds some colour to the case. This caught our attention—this chatbot could potentially become something. While other chatbots just give answers, Kotae gives context to what the user asks. It was straightforward and easy to implement. The option to scan our website is unique and brings up specific topics it recognizes.” – G.W.

“This is seriously helpful for small businesses! Automating customer inquiries with an AI that uses your own data? That’s just brilliant. This is going to make a huge difference for so many businesses!” – G.K.

“Love when makers think on small businesses because most of them are gonna be big then. And being able to support customers is a real game-changer for them.” – G.M.

“Wow, it’s smarter than I expected!” – V.M.

“No code setup is amazing!” – N.M.

Development

This plugin interacts with external services provided by Kotae AI. Here are the details:

  1. Resources Used:

    • Kotae Embed Script: A JavaScript file (index.min.js) for integrating AI functionality into your WordPress site.
    • Kotae Embed Stylesheet: A CSS file (index.min.css) for styling the embedded components.

  2. Servers Being Called:

    • https://kotae.ai/embed/index.min.js: The JavaScript script library for embedding chatbot functionality.
    • https://kotae.ai/embed/index.min.css: The stylesheet for styling the components.

  3. Account Requirements:

    • An active Kotae AI account is required to access and utilize the full range of services. You can create an account at https://kotae.ai.
    • Chatbot Id is needed for installation process. These can be obtained from your Kotae account dashboard.

Privacy and Data Usage

This plugin does not collect or store any data directly. However, it does load resources from external servers. Users are advised to review Kotae AI’s Privacy Policy for details about how their data is handled when interacting with the external services.
sections.installation:
To install this Kotae plugin

  1. Install this Kotae plugin to your WordPress website by:

    1. Click Download on the top right of this page. You will get a plugin in a .zip format.
    2. Log in and head to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin
    3. Click Choose file and select the downloaded .zip file.
    4. Click Install Now. You will be redirected to a page with the status of plugin installation.
    5. Once the plugin is installed successfully, click Activate Plugin.

  2. Log into the Kotae dashboard and copy your Chatbot ID from the Install tab. Click Copy ID on the WordPress card.

  3. Navigate to your WordPress site and click on the Kotae chatbot tab under the Settings menu in the sidebar.

  4. Paste your Chatbot ID into the chatbot ID placeholder field and click Add.

  5. Activate Kotae – AI Chatbot Plugin for WordPress through the Plugins menu in WordPress.

To deactivate or uninstall a plugin

  1. Log in and head to ​​Plugins > Installed plugins to see all the installed plugins on your WordPress site

  2. Scroll down to the plugin you want to remove. Click Deactivate

  3. Click Delete to uninstall the plugin
